paite: Huan mipite'n TOUPA zak a phun in thil hoih lou pipi agen ua; TOUPA'N huai azak in ahehta hi. Huchi in TOUPA mei alak uah ahong kuang a, giahphual ponungpen a omte akangta hi.
heading: Taberah Kichi Mun Khat
english: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger was kindled; and Yahweh’s fire burnt among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

paite: Huchi in mipite'n Mosi asam ua; TOUPA kiang ah Mosi athum a, huai mei amitta hi.
english: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.

paite: TOUPA mei alak ua ahong kat ziak in, huai mun min Taberah asa hi.
english: The name of that place was called Taberah Taberah means “burning” , because Yahweh’s fire burnt among them.

paite: Alak ua mikihel pawl khat in sa lunggulhna ahon neita ua; Israel suante leng akap nawn ua, "Kua'n ahia nek ding sa hon pe ding?
heading: Mosi In Heutu Sawmsagih Atel
english: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us flesh to eat?

paite: Ut leh dah a Aigupta gam a ngasa i nek zelte i theigige ua, tangmaite, mazelte, phulun sialnek chite, vaiphulunte, phulun ngou leng.
english: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

paite: Himahleh tu in i guhngek uh akeu khinta, bangmah lamet ding a-om kei, manna lel lou ngal," achi uhi.
english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

paite: Manna bel koriandar tang bang, alatdan in bedeli suang bang ahi.
english: The manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like the appearance of bdellium.

paite: Mite'n atomkhawm ua, gawinelna in agawinel ua, sum in asu ua, belte ah ahuan ua, tanghou in abawl uhi. Nek in sathau a kan tanghou abang hi.
english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

paite: Giahphual a zan a dai akiak in manna leng ahong kia hi.
english: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

paite: Mipite a-inkuankuan un apuanin kongkhak chiat uah akap uh, chih Mosi in ana za hi. TOUPA aheh mahmah a; Mosi leng alungkim kei hi.
english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the anger of Yahweh was kindled greatly; and Moses was displeased.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Bangziak in ahia na sikha na hon sukgim a, bang ahia na mit ka tunlouhna, hiai mite tengteng puakgik ka tung a na ngak?
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated with your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

paite: Hiai mipite tengteng ka suan ahi ua hia? Api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a piak na chiam gam a pilut ding in. Naupommi in nawitui ne lai a pom bang in na angsung ah pom in, na hon chih dia ka pikhiak?
english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them forth, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers?’

paite: Hiai mipi tengteng piak ding sa koi a pan ka nei dia? 'Ka nek ding un sa hon pia in,' chi in akap ngal ua.
english: Where could I get meat to give to all this people? For they weep to me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

paite: Hiai mipi tengteng keimah kia in ka po zou kei. Kei a ding in agik lua hi.
english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

paite: Hichibang a hon hih ding na hihleh, hon sisak vanglak in, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, ka gentheihna hon musak nawn mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
english: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Israelte Upa, mipite Upa leh aheutute uh hi a na theih mi sawmsagih ka kiang ah hon pikhawm inla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah nangmah toh dingkhawm ding in hon pi in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

paite: Huchi in ka hong pawt dia, huai ah ka hong houpih ding. Na tung a om kha om pen atung uah ka koih ding. Nang kia'n po lou in mipite puakgik ahon puakpih ding uhi.
english: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you not bear it yourself alone.

paite: Nang mipite kiang ah, zingchiang a ding in kihihsiangthou vek unla; huchi in sa na ne ding uh. Sa nek ding kuan ahia hon pe ding? Aigupta gam a nuam i saksak uh toh, chi in TOUPA zak in na kap ua; huaiziak in, TOUPA'N noute sa ahon pe dia, huchi in na ne ding uhi.
english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves against tomorrow, and you will eat flesh; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us flesh to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you flesh, and you will eat.

paite: Ni khat kia, ni nih kia, ni sawm kia, ni sawmnih kia leng na ne kei ding ua;
english: You will not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,

paite: himahleh kha khat pumlum, na nakvang ua ahong pawtkhiak a nou a dia kihhuai ahong hih masiah na ne ding uh. Na lak ua om TOUPA na deih louh ua, Aigupta gam a pan bangziak a paikhia i hi ua? chi a, ama a na kah ziak un," achi hi.
english: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because that you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

paite: Mosi in, "Ka ompih mipite khe a pai thei kia leng nuaiguk ahi ua; kha khat pumlum nek ding in sa ka pe ding, na chi hi.
english: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.’

paite: Belamhon leh ganhon leng gohsak lehang leng, akham ding ua hia? Tuipi a ngasa tengteng leng matsak vek lehang leng, akhamzou ding ua hia?" achi hi.
english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

paite: TOUPA'N, Mosi kiang ah, "TOUPA khut tomsak ahi a hia? Na tung ah ka thu bang a, atun leh tun louh na thei mai ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

paite: Mosi apawt a, TOUPA thu mipite ahilh hi. Mipite Upa sawmsagihte asamkhawm a, puanin kim ah adingsak hi.
english: Moses went out, and told the people the words of Yahweh; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

paite: Meipi ah TOUPA ahong suk a, ahong houpih a, ama tung a om Kha pen Upa sawmsagihte tung ah akoih hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, atung ua kha akoihtak in thu agen ua; agen zom sawt kei uhi.
english: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders: and it happened that when the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

paite: Himahleh giahphual ah mi nih a-om lai ua, khat min Eldad ahi, akhat pen min Medad ahi. Atung uah kha a-om a, upate lak a min khum ahi ua, himahleh kihoupihna biakbuk ah bel ahoh kei uhi. Giahphual ah thu agen uhi.
english: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested on them; and they were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

paite: Huchi in tangval khat ava tai a, Mosi ava hilh a, "Eldad leh Medad in giahphual ah thu agen uh," achi hi.
english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

paite: Nun tapa Joshua, atuailai a pan Mosi nasempa'n adawng a, "Ka toupa Mosi, kham ve,” achi hi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

paite: Mosi in akiang ah, "Kei gum a na thikthu sia hia? Pathian mi tengteng zawlnei hi vek le uh, TOUPA'N atung uah tua Kha koihchiatleh chi zomah lai ka hi!" achi hi.
english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

paite: Huchi in Mosi leh Israel Upa tengteng giahphual ah alut nawn uhi.
english: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

paite: TOUPA a pan huih ahong nung a, tuipi a pan vengkeng ahon mutleng a, giahphual lehlam sang ni khat lam, alehlam ni khat lamtuak dimsuak in giahphual kim ah tong nih ding a sang in akesak hi.
heading: Pathian In Vengkeng Asawl
english: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

paite: Mipite'n huai ni nitum leh zankhua leh azing nitum tan in vengkeng ava tomkhawm ua; atom tawmpen in leng homer sawm atom hi. Giahphual kim ah amau a chiat aphou uhi.
english: The people rose up all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; 1 homer is about 220 litres or 6 bushels and they spread them all abroad for themselves around the camp.

paite: Huai sa anek lai un, anek khit ma un, mipite tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, TOUPA'N hipi nasatak in mipite agawtta hi.
english: While the flesh was yet between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of Yahweh was kindled against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.

paite: Hiai mun min Kibroth-hattaavah asa a; huai a saduhte avui ziak un.
english: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, Kibroth Hattaavah means “graves of lust.” because there they buried the people who lusted.

paite: Kibroth-hattaavah a pan mipite Hazeroth ah apai ua; Hazeroth ah agiahphual uh asat uhi.
english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.
